note: RE-EXTRACTION 2026-08 (02024L1760-20260318): the Omnibus I amendment (Directive (EU) 2026/470) repealed former Article 22 'Combating climate change' in its entirety - the consolidated text jumps directly from Article 21 (Single helpdesk) to Article 23 (Authorised representative), with a repealed-provision marker in its place. That article carried every one of this act's previous candidate quotes (Art 1(1)(c) subject-matter cross-reference, Art 22(1) transition-plan obligation, Art 22(1) 2nd subpara point (a) time-bound GHG targets, Art 22(3) 12-month update cycle, Art 15(1) supervisory-authority oversight of the transition plan) - none has a surviving equivalent. A full re-read of the remaining enacting terms (Articles 1-39 and annexes) found no other timebound or quantitatively-progressive provision: the due-diligence articles (Arts 7-14) mandate company-internal processes and self-set action-plan timelines (a process obligation to set objectives later, not a Directive-imposed target), Article 15 'Monitoring' only requires periodic reassessment at least every 5 years with no substantive goal, and Article 16 sets a reporting deadline (12 months after balance-sheet date) with no quantified content. The independent deterministic regex sweep over the same replaced source text (scripts/policy-targets-input/_regex.json) likewise returns zero candidates for csddd, corroborating this reading. Net effect: 4 -> 0, unresolved - the climate-transition-plan obligation this policy_id existed to represent in the register no longer has a textual home in CSDDD; the equivalent disclosure-only provisions (Directive 2013/34/EU Art 19a/29a inserted by CSRD) are already tracked under policy_id 'csrd'.
